scope: Proposition 15.3 (High-cluster sampling stages) of the manuscript “The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order” (preprints/The-hypercube-Ramsey-number-has-linear-order-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 171 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7d4b26e897038267), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 128. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an admissible W-history with the preceding column-load success. There is a conditional bin sampler satisfying the star mass tests, the small-bin distinctness tests when relevant, and the prescribed label-column capacity. On the stated local scopes it has upper comparison with independent group choices. For every successful bin history there is then an odd injection satisfying all even-row mass gates, with the label-stage comparisons described below. These stages are conditional samplers; completing a stage does not reweight its incoming history.
